title: September 2026 Major Update
tagline: 1-Click AI Tailoring, Multi-Session Terminal, Copilot & Redesigned UI
headline: What's new in Career-Ops
subheadline: 1-Click Resume Tailoring, Parallel Multi-Session Terminals, Career Copilot, and an all-new modern UI.

features.title: 1-Click AI Resume Tailor
features.summary: Paste any job URL and get an ATS-optimized tailored resume in 60 seconds.
features.detail: Zero terminal commands, zero setup. Just paste any LinkedIn, Indeed, Greenhouse, or Lever link right on your dashboard to extract requirements and compile tailored docs automatically.

features.title: Multi-Session Parallel Terminal
features.summary: Run multiple discovery scans and resume tailoring tasks simultaneously.
features.detail: Execute broad job scans, GCC employer hunts, and deep tailoring in parallel tabs without waiting for previous jobs to finish.

features.title: AI Career Copilot
features.summary: Your personal career strategist trained on your profile and goals.
features.detail: Generate personalized recruiter outreach on LinkedIn, prep interview answers using the STAR method, and detect skill gaps before submitting applications.

features.title: Modernized UI/UX & Kanban Funnel
features.summary: Sleek dark-accented interface with mobile-first responsiveness.
features.detail: Enjoy a refreshed visual design, responsive layouts on iPhone and Android, interactive 5-stage application Kanban, and real-time status updates.

features.title: Interactive Resume Studio & ATS Scoring
features.summary: Real-time JD match scoring with live WYSIWYG editor.
features.detail: Compare your resume against any job description in real-time, fine-tune competencies on the fly, and download polished PDFs instantly.

features.title: Interview Practice Arena
features.summary: In-browser coding and system design interview sandbox.
features.detail: Sharpen your technical interview readiness with live code execution, DSA question packs, and complexity breakdown right inside Career-Ops.
